description: Lays out one of the app's tarot spreads (Single card, Question · Answer, Three cards, Lunation arc, Relationship mirror, Decision fork, Seven cards, Celtic Cross, Twelve houses) and draws a card for each position. Returns the spread, then for every position its name, what that position means and the card drawn with its reading. By default only the 22 major arcana are drawn, as in the app; deck "full" draws from all 78. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

deck.description: majors: the 22 major arcana (default); full: all 78 cards.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

name: tarot_spread
